rows.description: a monitor sits on a desk facing us. it's to the right of a lamp.
this is a standard white square bed pillow.  facing the night stand, it is the bottom pillow closest to the night stand on the bed to the right of the night stand.
the tan coffee table is between two opposite facing chairs. it is opposite the drinking fountain.
this is the bottom roll and another roll can be found above it.  a long handle running perpendicular to it can be found above the two rolls.
there is an office chair. it is to the right of the chair in the corner and facing the window.
there is a white folded chair leaning against the wall. it is to the left of the other folded chair leaning against the wall.
this is the grey couch chair in the center. it is smooth and facing to the right.
this is a wooden cubicle desk in the library. it is facing the book shelves and is near the window.
the sofa chair is facing the table. the sofa chair is to the left of the other chair.
this is a brown armchair. it is facing up and to the left.
there is a rectangular radiator. it is under a window and facing a table.
the object is a file cabinet. it is located directly in front of the radiator on the right side of the table if you were facing  the radiator.
there is a rectangular tv. it is facing the end of a table.
this chair is facing away. it is brown.
